The Term Sheet sets forth the terms of CKGC’s proposed pursuit of a direct listing of its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Stock Market or New York Stock Exchange (the “Direct Listing”), as well as a private placement by the Investor of 4,000,000 shares of Class A common stock or equivalent units at $8.00 per share or unit for an aggregate purchase price of $32 million, and a reorganization of CKCG into a Delaware corporation to be known as “Kaz Resources Inc.”, to be completed prior to the proposed Direct Listing. The Term Sheet also contemplates that the Company will receive an aggregate of 63,994,955 shares of CKCG Class A common stock through a series of private transactions, including (i) the distribution of CKCG shares held by Kaz Resources in exchange for the redemption of 100% of the Company’s equity in Kaz Resources, and (ii) an issuance by CKCG of shares in exchange for cancellation of all amounts due under the Skyline Loan and termination of the related note. These 63,994,955 shares of Class A common stock will represent approximately 26% of the equity CKCG as of a time immediately prior to the Direct Listing , before giving effect to a contemplated employee stock option plan of up to 10% of CKCG’s fully diluted capitalization. The contemplated transactions remain subject to receipt of requisite regulatory approvals, and the parties have agreed to cooperate in obtaining approvals and preparing necessary transaction documents. There can be no assurance that the transactions described in the Term Sheet will be completed. The Term Sheet may be terminated by written consent of all parties thereto. (the “Transaction Agreement”). The Termination Agreement became effective immediately upon its execution. As a result, the Transaction Agreement is of no further force or effect, except for certain provisions that survive its termination in accordance with their terms, and all liability under the Transaction Agreement on the part of any party thereto or any of their respective representatives shall cease. The Company also agreed to change its ticker symbol and release the “KAZR” symbol as promptly as possible, and in any event within 15 days following the date of the Term Sheet. Upon effectiveness of that change, CKCG will have the right to reserve the “KAZR” symbol.
